main.description: One stream overlay for OBS (or anything that takes a browser source), shown at dame.is/overlay/{rkey} on a 1920x1080 canvas. The record key is the overlay's id in that address: lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Widgets are placed on the site's own page grid carried onto the canvas: 16 columns and 9 rows of square 92px cells with 24px gutters, the same column and gutter as the site's grid at a desktop width. The page reads the record from the PDS without signing in and follows changes live, so a save shows on stream within seconds. Edited in the admin's Overlays studio. The structure follows atpota.to's to.atpota.poe.overlay, with its full-screen scenes folded in: a scene here is an overlay with an opaque backdrop.

name.description: What the overlay is called in the studio ("starting soon").

backdrop.description: transparent: nothing behind the widgets, to sit over a capture. page: the hour's page colour fills the canvas, for a full-screen scene. Absent is transparent.

hour.description: Paint the overlay in this hour's sky palette (Eastern hours, as the site). Absent follows the clock, so the overlay drifts through the day with the site.

grid.description: Draw the page grid's column and row lines faintly on the canvas, as the site draws its columns.

widgets.description: What is on the canvas, painted in order (a later widget sits over an earlier one where they overlap).

kind.description: title: words the overlay sets (a heading and a line under it). countdown: to a time, or a timer from when the overlay is shown. clock: the time now. day: the day of life, as the site's chrome counts it. status: the latest is.dame.now. music: what teal.fm says is playing. vitals: the latest is.dame.state. chat: the stream.place chat (place.stream.chat.message records naming this repo as the streamer). frame: an empty, ruled window to line a screen or camera capture up with. mark: the hour's sky avatar and the wordmark. links: where to find dame, a line each.

col.description: The grid column its left edge is on.

row.description: The grid row its top edge is on.

surface.description: What it is drawn on: nothing, a plate of the page colour, or the chrome's raised surface. Both plates are ruled with a hairline. Absent is page.

scale.description: Its type size, in percent of the usual.

align.description: Where its words sit across its box.

size.description: title: how big the heading is set.

text.description: title: the heading. frame: the label in its corner.

subtitle.description: title: the line under the heading.

label.description: The small-caps line over a widget's reading ("starting in", "dame is listening"). Absent is the widget's own; an empty string drops it.

mode.description: countdown: a timer of `minutes` from when the overlay is shown, or to the time `at`.

at.description: countdown: the time it counts to.

done.description: countdown: what it says at zero.

zone.description: clock: New York time (the site's clock) or the streaming machine's own.

max.description: chat: how many messages at most.

art.description: music: show the album cover. mark: show the sky avatar.
